title: Balance-sniffing accounting allows external phUSD donations to inflate totalDebt() and leak into _safePay buffer

classification.assetImpact: No staker funds at risk. Donated funds are stranded on-contract (no re-fold path); totalDebt() over-reports by donation size; _safePay may silently spend donated funds as a truncation buffer, masking accounting drift.
attackPath: 1. External actor transfers phUSD directly to the staker contract.
2. totalDebt() immediately reports balance - rewardBudget, over-reporting owed funds by the donation.
3. Donation consumed opportunistically by _safePay rounding overages; remainder stranded.
classification.likelihood: low - requires someone to voluntarily donate funds; impact is observability only.

justification: Low/QA. View-only mis-reporting and dust-buffer side-effect. No staker funds at risk; the donor's funds are the only value affected and they are voluntarily contributed. Fits QA-tier accounting-drift pattern. C4 does not elevate donation-accounting issues to Medium unless there is a realizable value leak.
